title: CQDiggings modelled gold transport potential
purpose: Highlight flow-directed watercourse corridors downstream from record-derived hard-rock source evidence, with added support where recorded alluvial evidence lies near the corridor.
not_a_claim: The model is not proof that gold is present or remains.
The model is not an estimate of gold quantity or grade.
A modelled corridor is not permission to enter or fossick.
Current watercourses may not reproduce historical or buried drainage.

method.watercourse_direction_assumption: Queensland metadata describes the network as flow directed; coordinate ordering is used as supplied and requires field-by-field validation.
